title: Squat jump: stand, squat, jump, land
tagline: Rewarded for the action, not for copying the clip: the Tracking, Task and Task (no reference) policies completed every stage (9/9) with 0 falls; the task policies did it 0.4–1.1 m (mean torso distance) away from the clip's own path.

story.shown: The squat jump phone video, retargeted to G1 proportions. Its stages: Stand → Squat → Jump → Land → Stand → Squat → Jump → Land → Stand.
story.learned: A policy rewarded mainly for completing those stages in order, with V-JEPA 2 similarity as a style term weighted toward the moments that matter. The episode ends only on a fall.
story.how: A stage checker reads only the robot's own body: feet on or off the floor, centre-of-mass height.

grid_caption: Solid robot: the trained policy, physically simulated. Green ghost: the reference it was shown.

extra.label: What V-JEPA 2 compares: silhouettes of the video and each robot

metrics.label: Jump quality
metrics.note: per jump; 1 = apex within the clip's height range

policies.label: Tracking
policies.reward: Copies the retarget's joint angles (the standard motion-imitation reward).

policies.label: Task
policies.reward: Rewarded for completing the action's stages in order (stand, squat, jump, land), plus V-JEPA 2 style. Ends only on a fall.

policies.label: Task (no reference)
policies.reward: Like Task, but the policy never sees the retarget: only its own body, a clock and the current stage.
